scope: Twenty-four instrumented exported journeys on one Windows runner, four repetitions in AB/BA/AB/BA order. Fresh means empty user data, not cold OS caches; retained New Acc and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after a real manual save. Timed New Acc ends before that save. Both variants clear audio after saving and allow 100 ms plus one frame before diagnostic exit; this teardown is outside action timing. Inclusive costs overlap and must not be summed. Screenshot hashes establish integrity; visual review remains required. Four samples per variant/case are descriptive, not statistical certainty.

source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after a real manual save. Verbose engine logging is enabled equally to identify shutdown resources. OS caches are not cleared.
